finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a user-supplied URL with no validation. An attacker can make the server request internal services, cloud metadata endpoints such as 169.254.169.254, or localhost. The first 500 characters of the response body are returned to the attacker, so this is a full-read SSRF.
finding.sink: requests.get(target, timeout=5) at app.py:16, with the response body returned at app.py:17

trace.note: requests.get(target) is called directly with that value; redirects are followed by default
resp.text[:500] and the status code are returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: None. There is no scheme check, no host allowlist, no private-IP or loopback blocklist, and no redirect restriction. Only a 5s timeout is set, and that does not mitigate SSRF.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the attacker-controlled 'url' query param and passes it straight to requests.get at app.py:16 with no validation, and app.py:17 returns the first 500 chars of the body. The ALLOWED_HOSTS check exists only in /partner (app.py:24), not in /preview.
